name: M'ONDUNIQ GENEXEM Exobiocell exosome mask
shortDescription: Exosome bio-cellulose mask with GENEXEM-LAKEI exosomes, oligopeptides and hyaluronic acid. For regeneration after microneedling, laser and RF treatments. 5 pcs / pack. The perfect partner for THE FROST cold plasma treatments: after cold plasma, the active ingredients are utilized far more effectively.
description:
The M'ONDUNIQ GENEXEM Exobiocell Exosome Bio-Cellulose Mask is a professional skincare mask that combines the advantages of bio-cellulose technology with innovative, regenerating active ingredients. Its formula contains GENEXEM-LAKEI exosomes (Lactobacillus-derived extracellular vesicles), bioactive oligopeptides, hyaluronic acid, aloe vera extract, soluble collagen, as well as fermented and vitamin-based ingredients to intensively hydrate the skin, support its natural regeneration processes and restore skin comfort.

The bio-cellulose carrier adheres to the facial skin extremely gently, so the serum is in even contact with the skin surface, ensuring optimal delivery of the active ingredients. During the treatment the skin immediately feels more hydrated, fresher and more revitalized, and with regular use it helps preserve the skin's elasticity and gives it a more even, radiant appearance.

Especially recommended for aftercare following professional aesthetic treatments – such as microneedling, laser, radiofrequency or other skin-resurfacing procedures – when the skin needs increased hydration, soothing and regenerative support.

faq.question: How should the mask be used?
faq.answer: Place the bio-cellulose mask on the cleansed facial skin and leave it on for 15–20 minutes. After removing it, gently massage the remaining serum into the skin until fully absorbed. No rinsing required.

faq.question: How many masks are in a pack?
faq.answer: Pack size: 5 premium exosome bio-cellulose masks / pack.

faq.question: Which skin types is the mask recommended for?
faq.answer: Recommended for sensitive skin, dehydrated skin, mature skin, dull and tired skin, skin in need of regeneration, and for aftercare following aesthetic treatments.

faq.answer: The bio-cellulose carrier adheres to the facial skin extremely gently, so the serum is in even contact with the skin surface, ensuring optimal delivery of the active ingredients. Its bio-cellulose structure ensures an excellent fit and even release of the active ingredients.
